description: This PHP class 'jiradbInterface' implements an interface for interacting with a Jira issue tracker database within a larger issue tracking integration system. It provides methods for connecting to the database, retrieving issues and statuses, and constructing configuration templates, suggesting it serves as a database backend interface for Jira issues.

classes.name: jiradbInterface
classes.description: A class that interfaces with Jira's database schema to retrieve and manage issue data, including fetching issue details, statuses, and configuration templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, establishes database connection, loads statuses, and configures Jira version.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Parses the Jira version string and validates it.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific issue from the Jira database.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the PHP interface configuration property.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Fetches the list of statuses from the Jira database.

methods.name: getStatusDomain
methods.description: Returns the internal mapping of status names to status IDs.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a Jira issue ID.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration snippet for Jira database connection.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API (returns false).
